item.title: Hello World
item.description:
This is my first post.

Why this blog

Life is full of small thoughts, failed attempts, half-clear intuitions, and occasional moments where something finally makes sense. Many of them are too rough to become papers, but too useful to disappear.

Writing things down might be a way for release.
